item.description: The deduplication functionality is not properly implemented. Tests show that duplicate file detection and handling is broken, particularly in the test_dedup.py file where it fails at the handshake stage.
item.contract: Implement proper deduplication logic that handles file content hashing and duplicate detection. The system should detect when files with identical content are uploaded and either return existing references or properly handle the deduplication process. The handshake mechanism needs to correctly respond with existing file references when duplicates are detected.

item.description: The move/rename functionality is not implemented. Tests in test_mv.py fail because the MOVE HTTP method handler is missing or incomplete.
item.contract: Implement the handle_move() method in HttpCli to properly handle MOVE HTTP requests. This should support moving files between directories and updating the filesystem accordingly, including handling cross-volume moves and maintaining proper file references in the database.

item.description: The SVG generation for icons is incorrect. The test_dots.py test expects specific SVG output with text elements but receives different content, indicating the icon generation logic needs correction.
item.contract: Fix the SVG generation in the Ico class to produce the expected SVG output with proper text rendering. The SVG should display the extension text centered with appropriate styling and colors.

item.description: The hook system functionality is not properly implemented. Tests in test_hooks.py fail because the hook execution mechanism is missing or incomplete.
item.contract: Implement the hook execution system that processes hook configurations and executes appropriate hooks during file operations. This should handle both pre-upload and post-upload hooks as defined in the test cases.
